description:
Modern Windows optimizer, cleaner & debloater built with Rust, React and PowerShell.

Win-Optimizer-Pro is a flat, enterprise-style desktop app that automates cleanup, debloating, tweaking and system hardening on Windows 10/11. Auto-elevates on startup for instant cleanup. Deep Boot Guard (Ghost Startup Inspector) finds and disables startup apps Task Manager hides - registry Run keys, startup folders, scheduled tasks and background services - with a 1-click "Instant 5-Second Boot" preset.
